status: Called in by Secretary of State
decision_conditions:
TREE WORKS (COMPLIANCE):  All tree work shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard BS3998 - Recommendations for Tree Work.  In addition: 
a)   No fires shall be lit within [10] metres of the nearest point of the canopy of any retained tree.  No equipment, machinery or structure shall be attached to or supported by a retained tree.
b)   No mixing of cement or use of other contaminating materials or substances shall take place within, or close enough to, a root protection area that seepage or displacement could cause them to enter a root protection area. 
c)   No alterations or variations to the approved works or tree protection schemes shall be made without prior written consent of the local planning authority.

REASON:  In the interest of the protection of trees and to safeguard visual amenities.
description:
Tree Works Specification - BS 39982010 Tree Work - Recommendations
Front Garden:

T1 - Robinia (Robinia pseudoacacia)
Carry out a crown reduction of approximately 25%, reducing lateral and terminal branches to suitable secondary growth points in order to maintain a balanced and natural crown form.  Reduce limbs extending toward the property to provide a minimum clearance of 3 metres from the building, paying particular attention to branches overhanging the new flat roof.   Provide an additional 3 metres clearance from the adjacent streetlight to ensure adequate light levels and prevent obstruction.

T2 - Sycamore (Acer pseudoplatanus)
Undertake a crown reduction of approximately 25%, pruning back to suitable secondary growth points to maintain the natural crown profile.   Reduce limbs encroaching toward the building to provide a minimum 3 metres clearance, ensuring the tree remains balanced and structurally sound.

T3 - Magnolia (Magnolia grandiflora)
Reduce overall height and reshape to maintain a compact, balanced canopy.  Lightly prune and shorten protruding shoots to blend with the remaining crown, preserving the natural form and appearance.

Rear Garden
T4 - Cherry (Prunus avium)
Carry out a crown reduction of approximately 25%, pruning back to suitable secondary growth points to maintain an even crown structure and encourage healthy future growth.


Reason for works:
Regular tree maintenance
